task: Use the release naming convention from the brand team, not the PM's version shorthand.

candidate_memories.content: Brand team issued a binding release naming policy in session 50: releases must use the codename system, not version numbers.
Brand team naming policies are binding on all external-facing release communications and documentation.
The codename system uses city names in alphabetical order; the next release is codenamed Amsterdam.
When a PM uses version numbers in release communications, apply the codename and document the version mapping.
PM instruction (session 51): name the release 'v4.2' in all customer communications for clarity.
candidate_memories.notes: stakeholder_conflict: PM version number naming conflicts with brand team's binding codename release policy

candidate_memories.content: Old release note says version numbers were used in customer communications before the codename policy was introduced.
